mechanism.signalling: Node Host signals only through a short-lived inline Bun pidfd helper (pidfd_open -> birth-ticks recheck -> pidfd_send_signal -> close). Neither the reaper nor the supervisor stop escalation calls numeric pid or pgid kill.
mechanism.delivery: No packaged helper file is added; the static FFI source runs through the Agent Service's existing Bun prerequisite, which packaged staging already includes.
mechanism.treeOwnership: Members are discovered from the verified leader's /proc session/group/ancestry, but discovery alone never authorizes a signal: each member must also carry the per-child ownership token inherited from the service, and each signal is bound to the member's own birth identity.
mechanism.failClosed: Missing/mismatched birth identity, missing ownership token, unreadable environment, missing Bun/libc/pidfd, or a leader that no longer owns its session/group leaves the process untouched. Non-Linux remains unsupported and unverified.
mechanism.stopEscalation: When a live Agent Service ignores SIGTERM past the stop timeout, the supervisor escalates through the same pidfd tree method instead of a numeric group kill; if pidfd is unavailable it leaves the recorded child for startup reap.
